seo.title: Services
seo.description: Glide-out shelving for kitchens, pantries, bathrooms and closets across the Phoenix valley.

sections.heading: What we fit.
sections.body: Every shelf is measured in your home and cut to that opening. The room changes; the method does not.

image.alt: Fitted kitchen shelving measured to the opening

sections.heading: Browse by room.
sections.intro: Pick a room to see a few of the jobs we do there. Every shelf is measured on site and cut to your opening.

cards.title: Pots & Pans
cards.body: Full-extension pull-outs for the deep base cabinet that swallows your pots, pans and the lids that never match.

cards.title: Corner Cabinet
cards.body: The dead corner turned into shelving that swings or slides all the way out.

cards.title: Under the Sink
cards.body: Shelves cut around the trap and disposal, so the space under the sink is finally usable.

cards.title: Spice Racks
cards.body: Slim pull-outs and tiered inserts that keep every jar labelled-side-out and in reach.

cards.title: Walk-In Pantry
cards.body: Full-depth glide-outs down both walls, sized to what you actually store.

cards.title: Cabinet Pantry
cards.body: Two usable rows become four, so nothing expires behind something else.

cards.title: Corner Pantry
cards.body: Reaches the awkward back corner every fixed shelf gives up on.

cards.title: Custom Pantry Designs
cards.body: Built around odd heights, angled ceilings and the door you cannot move.

cards.title: Under the Sink
cards.body: Shelves that clear the trap, so the vanity holds more than a spare roll.

cards.title: Vanity Cabinets
cards.body: Full-extension pull-outs for towels, bottles and the hairdryer cord.

cards.title: Cabinet Organizers
cards.body: Dividers and tiered inserts that stop the cabinet becoming a drawer of chaos.

cards.title: Pull-Out Organizers
cards.body: Custom-cut inserts that keep bottles, tools and spares each in their lane.

cards.title: Closets & Wardrobes
cards.body: Shoes, linens and the vacuum you wrestle out every week, all within reach.

cards.title: Garage & Storage
cards.body: Heavy-duty glides rated for tools, bulk goods and the gear you stack too high.

cards.title: Laundry & Mud Room
cards.body: Pull-outs for detergent, baskets and the things that pile by the door.

cards.title: Office, Crafts & Entertainment
cards.body: Shallow pull-outs that keep supplies, media and gear sorted and in view.

image.alt: Open shelving for glassware and bottles

cards.title: Office & Crafts
cards.body: Shallow tiered pull-outs that keep supplies visible and sorted.

cards.title: Spirits & Wine
cards.body: Bottle-safe racks and glide-outs sized for stemware and decanters.

cards.title: Custom Layouts
cards.body: For the room that does not fit a category — we measure and build to it.

sections.heading: Book a free measure.
sections.body: An hour on site, a fixed quote, no pressure to book on the day.
